title: Number: topic test
description: A 25-minute test on the whole Number topic: 10 questions, 19 marks, from quick recall to exam-style problems. Questions are drawn at random from the question bank, so every attempt is different. It includes Extended content (the subtopics examined only on Papers 2 and 4), so Core candidates may meet a few questions beyond their syllabus.
instructions: Answer every question. You have 25 minutes. You may use a calculator. Give answers that are not exact to the accuracy each question asks for (three significant figures, or one decimal place for angles in degrees, when it does not say). Your answers are marked when you submit, and you then see the worked solutions.

sections.title: Section B: longer questions
sections.instructions: These questions are worth 2, 4 and 5 marks. Show your working: a correct method earns credit in the real exam even when the final answer is wrong.
